answer: Horn blanks wait on the button-maker's lathe, pale and close-grained. Proof of button-maker via horn button tally — a button the button-maker turns only after 631 buttons turn true without one cracking at the shank, each turned by the button-maker himself. vertex turns the blank round and shapes the dome. lantern drills the shank hole and smooths the rim. haven polishes the button and sorts it by size. Six hundred and thirty-one buttons must turn true without one cracking at the shank, and the next still cracks where the horn ran dry.
